description: Route LLM requests with Jev task-family classification and Artificial Analysis cost-per-task frontier walking. Public model id ailerix/auto only.

tools.name: route_preview
tools.description: Classify a prompt and return the frontier routing decision without executing a provider completion.

tools.name: create_completion
tools.description: Run a routed chat completion (non-streaming) and return assistant content plus the ailerix trace.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Fetch a persisted route event by generation id (from X-Ailerix-Generation-Id or completion id).

generation_id.description: gen_ UUID from a prior response.

tools.name: analytics_summary
tools.description: Aggregate routing analytics (requests, spend, latency percentiles, family breakdown).

tools.name: credit_balance
tools.description: Return USD balance and usage for the authenticated account, or anonymous tier status when auth is disabled.

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Start a Stripe checkout session for a credit pack and return the hosted checkout URL.
